title: Agent Issue Tracker Workflow Plan
description: A set of tracker items (Jira/Linear/GitHub Issues) and how an agent handled each one, for auditing tracker-working discipline: dedupe search, actionable acceptance criteria, honest status transitions, item<->diff linkage, and captured spawned work.

policy.description: Optional overrides for audit thresholds; unset fields fall back to strict defaults.

id.description: Tracker issue key or slug, e.g. 'PROJ-123', 'daemon-introspection-api', '#641'.

status.description: Must reflect observable work, not intent. See policy.requireEvidenceForDone / requireLinkedArtifactForActiveWork.

hasAcceptanceCriteria.description: True only if the item states explicit, checkable acceptance criteria (not just a task description).

dedupeSearched.description: True only if the tracker was actually searched for an existing item before this one was filed or picked up.

linkedArtifacts.description: Branch names, PR references, or commit shas that trace this item to a diff, e.g. 'PR #641', 'branch:feature/xyz', 'commit:a79dcd81'.

evidenceOnDone.description: Required proof when status is 'done'. Null/absent for non-done items.

ref.description: The PR/commit/artifact a reviewer can open to check the claim.

validated.description: Whether the ref was actually opened/checked, not just cited.

spawnedItemsCaptured.description: null when no new work was discovered mid-task (not applicable). true when discovered work was filed as new items. false when discovered work was NOT captured (scope-creep risk).
